posts.name: youperguy
posts.cooked:
I love SotM, but I always thought it would be fun to take on a Villain 1 on 1 sometime. Clearly the game is not designed for this, but it could be. 

 

The Vengenace villains were clearly designed to work together as a team, which made sense from a story perspective, but with Villains it would be cool if they would be set up to work by themselves. This would allow 1 on 1 duels between 1 hero and 1 Villain. I think this would be blast. I think it would also create a ton of excitment for Villains. 

I have already put my preorder in for Villains, but I would be very pumped if they allowed solo hero games.

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
For example 1v1 FrightTrain is a nightmare, where as in group fights he is rarely the most damgerous.

I'd say go for it, the fights can be a lot of fun, but there are numerous heroes that will struggle 1v1, while others excel.  (for example Legacy is not strong 1v1, but his daughter is awesome)

The same is true with villains, and I expect that with 10 more villains we will see more decks that are support/tank decks that might not balance well for 1v1.

 

The theme and play are fun, I've done several, I mean who doesn't want to replay that one time when Lt. Vance got stuck 1v1 with Fright Train, (that is not an easy fight) or the battle through the streets of Rook City after the Wraith caught Ermine in the act.
